flash_695324.description: Netanyahu confirms Egypt's intelligence chief visited Israel before October 7 but denies meeting him: "I want to know the truth. There are cameras."

flash_695323.description:
A Delta Air Lines flight delayed in New York following a bomb threat was cleared for takeoff to Tel Aviv after security checks were completed.

The threat was determined to be a hoax, marking the second false bomb threat made by a prankster since Tuesday morning.

flash_695322.description: Defense Minister Israel Katz warns that Iran and its proxies are attempting to carry out terrorist attacks aimed at influencing the outcome of Israel's elections.

flash_695331.description: US President Donald Trump on Tuesday night issued a warning to Iran, threatening the US would "do a number" on the Islamic Republic and hinting Washington has had it with Tehran's tactics.

flash_695330.description: President Trump says a decision on Iran is imminent, citing its economic crisis as speculation grows over possible renewed US strikes before the midterm elections.

flash_695328.description: Iran summons Britain's ambassador and threatens to reconsider relations after UK officials accused Tehran of directing a suspected plot at RAF Fairford.

flash_695326.description: Dutch police arrest a 20-year-old suspected of planning a terrorist attack near Rotterdam. Weapons seized after reports of his plans to kill multiple people.

flash_695345.description: IDF's 810th Brigade discovers ready-to-detonate explosive device, Hezbollah position, during operation near Kfar Shouba in southern Lebanon.

flash_695344.description: Rabbi Yitzhak Ginsburgh offers unexpected approach to overcoming screen addiction, urging people to redirect attachment to technology toward deeper connection with G-d.

flash_695343.description: Houthis developing ballistic missiles with a 2,000-kilometer range using Chinese components and Iranian assistance, Wall Street Journal reports says.

flash_695339.description: Everyone should make a list of the people they know and whom they can influence to go to the polling stations and vote.

flash_695337.description: Prime Minister Netanyahu claims Economic Party chairman Yaron Zelekha voted for Meretz and participated in anti-Netanyahu protests in Balfour and Kaplan.

flash_695335.description: Who truly changed after Oct. 7, and who demonstrated the ability to withstand enormous pressure when Jewish lives were on the line? Opinion.

flash_695333.description: Toronto police arrest a 29-year-old man accused of burning Israeli flags outside a church on the October 7 anniversary, amid continued antisemitic incidents.

flash_695329.description:
A man in his 30s was critically injured after his car crashed into the roadside in Tel Aviv.

Magen David Adom (MDA) paramedics evacuated him to Wolfson Hospital while performing CPR.

flash_695327.description:
Russia's Federal Security Service (FSB) announced that it had arrested a Japanese journalist on Sakhalin Island, north of Japan, on suspicion of gathering information about Russia's defense capabilities for Japanese intelligence.

According to the FSB, the journalist, who worked for the Hokkaido Shimbun newspaper, was detained while preparing to leave Russia. He was subsequently transferred to Moscow and imprisoned.

flash_695325.description:
A building belonging to the management of Saudi oil giant Aramco was attacked in the city of Dhahran in eastern Saudi Arabia, sparking a fire, the official Saudi Press Agency (SPA) reported, citing an Energy Ministry official. The official confirmed that no injuries were reported in the attack.

Meanwhile, Saudi Arabia's Civil Defense announced that four people were injured in Riyadh by falling debris from an interception. Minor damage was also reported to 15 residential buildings in the capital.

flash_695365.description:
Amcha Yisrael chairman Ofer Winter said in a statement to the media alongside members of his party: “I never believed it was possible to sink this low. In recent weeks, we have witnessed a coordinated campaign of smears, threats, and vicious attacks, funded with tens of millions of shekels, all aimed at harming Amcha Yisrael. In recent days, a red line has been crossed."

He added: “We are not giving in. We are going all the way, with full force."

flash_695364.description: Defense Minister Israel Katz warns Hezbollah against joining Iranian attack on Israel, saying IDF will seize additional territory in southern Lebanon, strike Beirut's Dahieh district.

flash_695362.description:
President Isaac Herzog landed in Baku, Azerbaijan, for a day-and-a-half-long visit, during which he will participate in the Seventh CICA Summit, the Conference on Interaction and Confidence Building Measures in Asia, an international forum dedicated to strengthening cooperation and ties among the nations of Asia.

Later today, President Herzog will hold a diplomatic meeting with President Ilham Aliyev of Azerbaijan, during which the two presidents will discuss deepening strategic cooperation and strengthening relations between Israel and Azerbaijan.

During his visit, President Herzog will deliver an address at the summit’s plenary session and will hold a series of bilateral meetings with world leaders attending the summit. The President will conclude his visit with a meeting with the leaders of the Jewish community of Azerbaijan.

flash_695361.description: Firefighting crews have brought the fire at the Intel plant in Kiryat Gat under control and are continuing efforts to extinguish the blaze and prevent it from spreading. Authorities said nitrogen trifluoride, a nonflammable substance with oxidizing properties, is involved at the site. The area has been cordoned off within a half-kilometer radius. The circumstances of the incident are under investigation.

flash_695360.description: Two Intel employees were critically injured in a Kiryat Gat factory fire as police investigate a possible gas explosion and hazardous materials leak.

flash_695358.description: Hazardous materials leaked in Kiryat Gat

flash_695356.description: Bus driver killed, 19 others injured in collision between bus and truck on Highway 91 near Mahanaim Junction.

flash_695354.description: Six-month-old infant who missed routine vaccinations hospitalized with bacterial meningitis at Shaare Zedek Medical Center.

flash_695352.description: Former hostage Rom Braslavski launches new talk show on Channel 2000, days after asking for a chance to be heard beyond his captivity story.

flash_695350.description: The National Committee for the Administration of Gaza has signed an agreement with Germany’s GIZ development agency to support reconstruction, economic recovery, public services and institutional development across the Gaza Strip.

flash_695348.description: IDF eliminates Hamas commander Momen Ahmad Salameh Ay, who helped hold Israeli hostages captive and violated Gaze ceasefire, in Gaza City strike.

flash_695346.description: The government is expected to approve the transfer of more than NIS 1 billion to accelerate payments for Israel’s Apache attack helicopter procurement deal, with most of the funding coming from cuts to the five-year development plan for Arab society.

flash_695342.description: US President Donald Trump announces plans for extensive oil, gas, and mineral exploration in Greenland, touting its vast natural resources.

flash_695340.description: UN rapporteur Francesca Albanese urges the ICC to investigate Israeli journalists and officials for alleged incitement to genocide, renewing controversy over her remarks.

flash_695338.description: This election is about far more than party affiliation; it is about the kind of New York we intend to leave to our children and grandchildren. Opinion.

flash_695336.description: Dr. Aliza Bloch warns of civil war at the Arutz Sheva-Israel National News conference, rejects calls for Blue and White to withdraw from the election, and urges a broad unity government.

flash_695387.description: Contradicting a report published by The Atlantic last month, Kan News reveals that two businessmen, not Egyptian intelligence chief Abbas Kamel, were aboard the Egyptian aircraft that landed in Israel 11 days before the October 7 massacre.

flash_695386.description: One of the victims in Intel plant fire pronounced dead

flash_695384.description: A 10-year-old boy was killed after a burning dumpster exploded in Beitar Illit, sending an object flying and striking him as crews rushed to the scene.

flash_695383.description: Channel 12: Netanyahu aide Yonatan Urich met with Qatari official at least twice during war

flash_695382.description:
President Isaac Herzog met on Wednesday with the Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Kingdom of Bahrain, Dr. Abdullatif bin Rashid Al-Zayani, in Baku, Azerbaijan.

During the meeting, they discussed the importance of strengthening the Abraham Accords, with the aim of expanding the circle of peace and cooperation in the region.

President Herzog emphasized the great importance Israel attaches to its relations with the Kingdom of Bahrain and commended the courageous leadership of His Majesty King Hamad bin Isa Al Khalifa and the Government of Bahrain. The President conveyed his warmest wishes to His Majesty the King and the Bahraini people.

Herzogwith Baharaini FMצילום: מעיין טואף, לע"מ

flash_695381.description: Prime Minister Andy Burnham condemns Green Party motion defining Zionism as racism, saying Labour cannot enter a partnership with a party that supports such a position.

flash_695380.description: President Isaac Herzog meets Azerbaijani President Ilham Aliyev on the sidelines of an international summit, discussing regional security and ways to strengthen strategic cooperation between Israel and Azerbaijan.

flash_695378.description: The 99th Division completed 4 months of operations in northern Gaza, eliminating terrorists involved in the October 7 massacre and hostage captivity, and dismantling Hamas infrastructure.

flash_695376.description: The Tanya compacts four millennia of Jewish wisdom to answer the great personal and existential questions of life. It has revolutionized the way we think about G -d the human soul, the world and our place in it. Epistle 24, Class 3.

flash_695374.description: Following government approval, Israel's Defense Ministry moves to finalize an agreement with the Pentagon for 12 Boeing Apache Echo helicopters, with deliveries expected early next decade.

flash_695372.description: The exile is finite, measured in time. But its end will show Hashem's endless and unmeasurable mercy.

flash_695370.description: LTG Zamir warns of increased potential for escalation across multiple fronts, condemns violence against innocent civilians during the olive harvest season.

flash_695368.description: Colombia inaugurated its Jerusalem embassy as the two countries restore ties, revive trade, and expand cooperation after a two-year diplomatic rupture.

flash_695366.description: Head of the Central Elections Committee's logistics division speaks with Arutz Sheva about the preparations, inclduing for worst-case scenarios.

flash_695363.description: Ronen Bar filed a defamation lawsuit against the Prime Minister, alleging that Netanyahu published false accusations about his role in the October 7 failures.

flash_695359.description: Rabbi Shmuel Eliyahu visited students mourning 14-year-old Elazar Yair Vilensky, killed by an unexploded munition on a school trip.

flash_695397.description:
Voting at Israeli diplomatic missions around the world has begun with the opening of the polling station at Israel's embassy in New Zealand.

Israeli diplomats worldwide will cast their ballots over the next 24 hours.

flash_695396.description: CENTCOM says US forces destroyed an Iranian-linked vessel targeting American warships in the Gulf of Oman, as Washington continues enforcing its naval blockade.

flash_695395.description: Violent clashes erupt near Bnei Brak as dozens of extremist protesters attempt to force their way into a building housing an IDF unit responsible for integrating haredi soldiers.

flash_695394.description: The message from Jerusalem must be unequivocal: the charade is over.

flash_695393.description: Noah survived the world. Abraham changed it.

flash_695391.description: Prime Minister Netanyahu and Foreign Minister Sa’ar welcome opening of Colombia’s embassy in Jerusalem and hail strengthening of relations between Israel and Latin America.

flash_695389.description: Rabbi Noam Oster, whose son was on the hike, praised the students who took charge after the deadly blast, calling them heroes and 'a nation of lions.'

flash_695385.description: The IDF has launched a process to evaluate acts of heroism during the battles from October 7 until the beginning of the ground offensive in Gaza.

flash_695379.description: A Bedouin terrorist was convicted of operating on behalf of a Gaza-based terrorist organization, providing intelligence on targets in Israel, and enlisting in the IDF on his handler's instructions.

flash_695377.description: Iranian and Turkish representatives protested after an Israeli delegate mentioned the October 7 massacre, but the Astana interfaith conference continued as planned.

flash_695375.description: Halakhot involving grapes due to their use in holy situations.

flash_695371.description: Shades of Noah, whose neighbors tried to destroy the Ark. In May 2018, Michael Ben Ari publicly warned that Gaza was a ticking time bomb. For that, he faces criminal charges for "incitement" that have not been dropped despite October 7 proving him right.

flash_695369.description:
Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu spoke a short time ago with Magen David Adom Director-General Eli Bin and asked about the condition of those injured in the explosion at the Intel plant in Kiryat Gat.

The MDA director-general updated the Prime Minister that the injured were quickly evacuated to Soroka Medical Center and are receiving the best possible treatment.

Netanyahu wished the injured a speedy recovery and thanked the emergency and rescue forces for acting quickly and decisively.

flash_695403.description: North Korea tests two types of submarine-launched cruise missiles amid stalled nuclear talks.

flash_695402.description: Mar Cheshvan - the secret of water.

flash_695401.description:
A man in his 40s and a 23-year-old woman were moderately injured in a collision between two vehicles on Highway 31 near Lehavim. Two other people sustained minor injuries.

Magen David Adom (MDA) teams treated the injured at the scene before evacuating them to Soroka Hospital in Be'er Sheva.

flash_695399.description:
Police reported that the car belonging to the chief of staff of the mayor of Elad caught fire. No injuries were reported.

The incident occurred shortly after a grenade was thrown at the home of the municipality's director-general.

flash_695392.description: New parliamentary caucuses in Athens and Nicosia aim to strengthen Israel's strategic partnerships in the Eastern Mediterranean, promote security and energy cooperation, and counter antisemitism and regional threats.

flash_695388.description: PM rejects claims made by former Shin Bet chief in NIS 3 million defamation suit against Netanyahu.

flash_695414.description: A group of 72 retired US generals, admirals and other senior military officers is urging the Trump administration to cancel plans to broadcast the execution of Nidal Hasan live.

flash_695413.description: Ger hasidim instructed to suspend election activities, raising fears United Torah Judaism could lose two Knesset seats.

flash_695412.description: CNN reports that the US military has developed new plans for potential strikes against Iran, including the possible deployment of one of its most destructive conventional weapons.

flash_695410.description: What lesson can be learned from God’s first words to Adam in the Garden of Eden? They were not about eating from the tree.

flash_695408.description: Turkish police raid Halk TV, the country's most-watched news channel, suspend broadcasts and detain 11 people in a widening crackdown on opposition media.

flash_695406.description: Iran's parliament speaker urges military readiness despite US negotiations, as Trump threatens further action and Tehran demands concessions over the Strait of Hormuz.

flash_695404.description: Irish author Sally Rooney's publisher will stop selling her books in Britain over legal concerns stemming from her support for the banned group Palestine Action.

flash_695400.description: Israel has reportedly blocked construction of a Gaza military outpost for Trump's Board of Peace, delaying deployment of international troops and reconstruction.

flash_695398.description: President Trump predicts the Iran war will end soon, claims Tehran would use nuclear weapons if it had them, and suggests further US military action remains possible.

flash_695390.description: A day before completing 12 years of military service, Major Y. received an urgent call to report to the Gaza Division headquarters. His community's rabbi urged him to stay and defend his neighbors instead.

flash_695435.description: Yashar! chairman Gadi Eisenkot pledges to end Hamas rule in Gaza, dismantle its military wing within 18 months if elected Prime Minister, drawing sharp criticism from Likud and Amcha Yisrael.

flash_695434.description: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu will convene a security meeting this evening with the heads of the defense establishment, including IDF Chief of Staff Lt. Gen. Eyal Zamir, Mossad Director Roman Gofman, Shin Bet Director David Zini, and Defense Minister Israel Katz.

flash_695432.description: Former MK Matan Kahana condemns term 'settler violence' as unfair attack on entire community, calls for tough crackdown on nationalist crime in Judea and Samaria.

flash_695430.description: New ADL Center for Technology and Society research finds 19 active accounts shaping framing on Israel, Hamas and October 7; biased editing has gone quiet, not away.

flash_695428.description: Police rule out foul play in Beitar Illit explosion that killed nine-year-old Eliyahu Azriel; investigators suspect dangerous play triggered blast.

flash_695426.description: Report claims President Isaac Herzog flew through Turkish airspace without Ankara's knowledge, Turkish and Iranian delegates walk out during his speech at Baku summit.

flash_695424.description: The first three first people to exclaim Baruch Hashem, were not part of our covenantal relationship with Hashem.

flash_695422.description: In the words of Soviet writer Sergei Dovlatov, “progressive humanity demands of Israel a noble suicide." Opinionl

flash_695420.description: Indian police have arrested a 32-year-old man suspected of setting fire to a compound adjacent to the historic Kadavumbhagam Synagogue in Kochi, India.

flash_695418.description: Two residents of Elad in their 20s and 30s have been arrested on suspicion of involvement in a grenade attack targeting the home of the city's director-general and the arson of a vehicle belonging to the mayor's chief of staff.

flash_695416.description: Hezbollah launched three reconnaissance drones into southern Lebanon's security zone over the past two weeks, IAF failed to intercept two of them but withheld details from the public, Galei Zahal report says.

flash_695411.description: The natural constituents of the Religious Zionist party should return home rather than chase the chimera of new politicians and new parties that will promise everything and deliver nothing. Opinion.

flash_695409.description: Nobel Peace Prize winner Navi Pillay calls for Netanyahu to face war crimes charges at the ICC, following sharp criticism from Israel over her selection.

flash_695407.description: Magal challenges Eisenkot over his opposition to dismantling the Palestinian Authority, accusing him of paving the way for a Palestinian state by opposing construction in E1.

flash_695458.description: Israel’s Ambassador to the UN, Danny Danon, issues a direct warning to Iran and Hezbollah: 'Anyone who dares to attack us will face a devastating response.'

flash_695457.description:
Israel has raised its level of alert in recent days amid concerns over a possible security escalation, less than two weeks before the elections, Kan News reported.

At this stage, there is no concrete information indicating that Iran or Hezbollah intends to attack, but the IDF is monitoring missile and drone tests being conducted by Iran.

A security official said: “We are acting to ensure that we are not caught by surprise."

flash_695456.description: President Donald Trump announces that Nidal Hasan's execution will proceed by firing squad, but will not be broadcast to the public. Victims' immediate families will be permitted to attend.

flash_695454.description: New York City officials have identified another victim of the September 11 terrorist attacks using advanced genetic genealogy, bringing the total number of identified victims to 1,655.

flash_695452.description: B'Tsalmo calls on Assaf Rappaport, who is in advanced talks to acquire the McDonald's Israel franchise, to end the chain's longstanding absence from Judea and Samaria.

flash_695450.description: Yakir Kososhvili, 35, from Ofakim, was one of those killed in the explosion at the Intel plant in Kiryat Gat. He was pronounced dead yesterday.

flash_695448.description: Hezbollah admits explosives seized in Lebanon belonged to the group, claiming they were intended for attacks on Israeli forces and demanding their return.

flash_695445.description: Safed Chief Rabbi Shmuel Eliyahu urges the public to vote, warning that “Jewish lives, the Torah of Israel, and the settlement of the Land of Israel" depend on it.

flash_695443.description:
This morning (Thursday), IDF soldiers completed a special operation in the Jenin area. During the operation, IDF soldiers, guided by the Shin Bet, apprehended a terrorist who was affiliated with the Jenin terror network, which was dismantled during Operation “Iron Wall," an operation aimed at dismantling terrorist networks in Northern Samaria.

The terrorist served as a key weapons trader and, during his involvement with the network, operated to acquire and transfer weapons to the Jenin terror network.

flash_695442.description: During an operation targeting illegal residents in Rahat, Southern District Border Police officers spotted a motorcyclist riding without license plates and after a chase found he was riding a stolen vehicle.

flash_695440.description: Amit Segal says Netanyahu may form a government with Gadi Eisenkot even with 61 seats, weakening Ben Gvir and the haredi parties, but questions claims that he plans to exclude them.

flash_695438.description: Israel's economy is projected to grow by 4.5% in 2026, the highest rate among countries classified by the IMF as Advanced Europe, ahead of Malta at 4.2% and Denmark at 3.7%.

flash_695436.description: A Health Ministry report projects the number of doctors in Israel will surge from approximately 37,000 to 53,000 within a decade, while the number of specialists will rise from about 20,300 to 32,000.

flash_695433.description: Yisrael Beytenu chairman Avigdor Liberman declared that he would not join a government led by Netanyahu or support a minority government as a temporary solution, outlining his proposed framework for the next coalition.

flash_695431.description: A Christian researcher says Christians living under Palestinian Authority rule face intimidation, religious restrictions, and economic pressure.

flash_695471.description:
A short while ago, an interceptor was launched toward a false target identified in the area in which IDF soldiers are operating in southern Lebanon, the IDF Spokesperson's Unit said.

No sirens were sounded in accordance with protocol.

flash_695470.description: Elyakim Shtark compares yeshiva students' fears of arrest at airports to restrictions on crossing borders during the Holocaust.

flash_695468.description: Following an initial investigation, Israeli security officials believe that the ramming incident near the community of Ateret in the Binyamin region, in which one person was reportedly lightly injured, was not a terrorist attack.

flash_695466.description: A person was reportedly lightly injured in a suspected ramming attack near Ateret in Binyamin. According to the report, the suspect fled the scene.

flash_695464.description: New details reveal Netanyahu's reported ultimatum to Syria's President during the Druze massacre, rejecting a 48-hour delay and threatening further strikes.

flash_695462.description: Draft-eligible individuals who fail to regularize their status must provide IDF clearance within five days of winning a civil service tender or risk losing the job.

flash_695460.description: A man in his 60s collapsed at his son’s wedding. Guests performed CPR and delivered three defibrillator shocks before MDA paramedics restored his pulse and he regained consciousness.

flash_695455.description: Customs officers were stunned to find 37 live venomous snakes and 55 lizards hidden in a Mexican passenger’s suitcase, concealed in shampoo bottles, socks and clothing.

flash_695453.description: IDF and ISA eliminated two terrorists who facilitated the smuggling of weapons and military equipment into Gaza.

flash_695451.description: Two years after Yahya Sinwar's elimination, the IDF reveals a letter from his 10-year-old son expressing longing for his father and a desire to shoot Jews.

flash_695449.description: Former minister Ayelet Shaked recalls election-season Shabbat visits to synagogues across Israel and expresses hope for a return to respectful debate without toxic polarization.

flash_695447.description: Five explosions reported at the presidential palace in Aden. Prime Minister and cabinet ministers unharmed, while two guards were killed and six others injured.

flash_695444.description: The United States Central Command (CENTCOM) confirmed Thursday that the USS George H.W. Bush has returned to the Arabian Sea following a visit to Thailand. The aircraft carrier's 5,000 crew members and embarked personnel continue to support CENTCOM operations in the Middle East during a scheduled deployment.

flash_695441.description: Netanyahu says he personally called Syrian President Ahmed al-Sharaa during the 2025 Suwayda massacre and vowed Israel would continue protecting Syria’s Druze.

flash_695481.description: Secretary of State Marco Rubio urges Lebanon to hold those behind a Hezbollah explosives shipment accountable and warns against returning the seized weapons to the group.

flash_695480.description: Report: Oregon school shooter was a 16-year-old teen

flash_695479.description: ‘Once they engaged in robbery - which inevitably leads to disharmony and the separation of hearts - they were called to account also for the severe transgressions they had committed till then.’

flash_695477.description: Although desire is a mere emotion, the Aseret HaDibrot prohibit it when it is misdirected.

flash_695475.description:
Police and prosecutors had planned to inform the Supreme Court on Thursday that the criminal investigation into the Mount Meron disaster would be reopened. However, the police legal adviser requested a one-month delay in submitting the notification, according to a report in Haaretz.

According to the report, the legal adviser, who is close to Knesset Speaker Amir Ohana, justified the request by citing the need to clarify certain matters with Police Commissioner Dani Levy.

flash_695474.description: At least three children and one adult killed in a shooting at an elementary school in Bend, Oregon. Suspect shot and killed.

flash_695473.description:
The IDF Spokesperson's Unit clarified, "Following the incident in the area of Ateret, an initial inquiry determined that the incident was not terror-related."

The driver was transferred to security forces, and officers from the Judea and Samaria District Police opened an investigation to establish the circumstances of the accident.

flash_695472.description: Several people, including children, injured in a shooting at an elementary school in Bend, Oregon. Police say the gunman is dead and at least two were hospitalized.

flash_695469.description: More than 5,000 activists and leading religious Zionist rabbis attend rally in Jerusalem. Smotrich warns voters against taking risks in the upcoming elections.

flash_695467.description: One reported lightly injured in suspected ramming attack near Ateret. Driver fled; IDF pursuing.

flash_695463.description: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu spoke on Thursday with US Secretary of State Marco Rubio.

flash_695461.description:
The District Court accepted the police appeal and overturned the decision regarding the security official from Samaria, whose identifying details are under a gag order.

His detention was extended by an additional five days, and he is expected to be transferred to an Israel Prison Service facility on Sunday. The judge asked law enforcement authorities to consider an earlier transfer and even his release before the end of the detention period.

flash_695459.description:
A violent riot broke out in the Abu Tor neighborhood of Jerusalem following a suspected murder and against the backdrop of an ongoing dispute between families.

According to police, a residential building and a vehicle were apparently set on fire during the riot. Police officers and Border Police forces are working to restore order, while firefighting crews were dispatched to the scene. No injuries have been reported at this stage.

flash_695493.description: Flavio Bolsonaro leads Brazilian President Lula 47% to 45% in a new Datafolha poll ahead of the October 25 runoff, narrowing his previous four-point advantage.

flash_695492.description: Marking two years since Yahya Sinwar's elimination, the IDF releases a handwritten document in which the Hamas leader ordered terrorists to document atrocities on October 7.

flash_695490.description: Indonesia's leading Islamic council calls for the cancellation of two Andrea Bocelli concerts, citing the Italian tenor's support for Israel and its military.

flash_695488.description: Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi urges Israel to reverse Jewish community construction in Judea and Samaria and reaffirms Beijing's support for a Palestinian state.

flash_695487.description: US Central Command disputes Iranian claims of control over the Strait of Hormuz, the sinking of a Singapore-flagged ship and hundreds of American military deaths.

flash_695485.description: Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi reiterates Beijing's support for Palestinian statehood and a two-state solution.

flash_695483.description: Trump when asked if he trusts Netanyahu: I don't trust anybody

flash_695482.description: President Trump says he will not use nuclear weapons against Iran and has no plans to deploy ground troops, amid reports of a possible MOAB strike.

flash_695478.description: Proofpoint agrees to acquire Israeli-founded cybersecurity company Varonis for $6.3 billion in cash, combining their data protection and AI security capabilities.

flash_695476.description: Judaism, not ancient Greece, is foundational to the moral greatness of the West. Opinion.

flash_695465.description: Israel is monitoring Iranian missile tests and regional threats amid fears that a miscalculation could trigger a wider conflict ahead of elections in Israel and the US.

flash_695510.description: Avshalom Revivo, 61, swerved his bus to protect 20 soldiers in a decision his employer believes saved their lives - but paid for it with his own life.

flash_695509.description: Noach had a duty not only to prepare for his own survival, but to give others the chance to save themselves. But there would never be enough room for that.

flash_695507.description: It does not seem logical that Jews living in lands whose rainy seasons differ from that of Eretz Yisrael should ask for rain according to the calendar of Eretz Yisrael!

flash_695505.description: MK Yuli Edelstein faces a heated confrontation aboard flight as left-wing activist hurls insults and accusations at him, while another activist calls for politicians to be pursued everywhere.

flash_695503.description: Police, Border Police, and Shin Bet launch extensive searches for masked individual wearing IDF uniform who may be armed.

flash_695501.description: Democrats chairman Yair Golan faces backlash after calling for religion's removal from public spaces; Shas leader Aryeh Deri hits back.

flash_695499.description: While the Torah places Noach's Ark on the mountains of Ararat, a closer look at the Rambam and Midrash suggests the ark may have ultimately come to rest near the future site of the Holy Temple.

flash_695497.description: Anti-Zionist Jews will do anything to try to preserve their position in society but they are playing a losing game with the non-Jewish world. And their abysmal response to October 7 showed their fellow Jews all their cards. Opinion.

flash_695495.description: Elon Musk unveils Tesla's new Roadster with rocket-like thrusters, showcasing aerial stunts and acceleration from 0 to 60 mph in under a second. Production is targeted for 2028.

flash_695491.description: After Yoav Horowitz accused Netanyahu of being a "Qatari agent," the Likud announces that the Prime Minister would file a 500,000-shekel defamation lawsuit.

flash_695489.description: German court sentences two men for plotting attacks on prominent pro-Israel figures on behalf of Iran's Quds Force and conducting surveillance of Jewish targets.

flash_695486.description: Three children - aged 5, 8, and 11 - and a teacher murdered in a shooting at an elementary school in Bend, Oregon. Shooter, a 16-year-old, shot and killed.

flash_695484.description: Prof. Yaron Zelekha unveils his party's economic platform, declaring he will join only a Zionist government that supports universal military service and appoints him finance minister.

flash_695519.description: The terrorist infiltrated the Re’im Base during the October 7 massacre and recently advanced attacks against IDF troops and Israeli civilians, in violation of the ceasefire.

flash_695518.description:
Johannes Natland, a 19-year-old Norwegian, was sentenced to 20 years in prison in the UK on Friday after being convicted of conspiracy to commit murder on behalf of the Swedish criminal network Foxtrot, which is linked to the Iranian regime.

Natland was arrested in March 2025 in a hotel room in northern England, hours before the planned murder, with two firearms and ammunition in his possession. He admitted possessing the weapons but denied intending to carry out the killing.

London police stressed that no evidence had been found linking Iran directly to this particular case.

flash_695517.description:
A paraglider was filmed flying in violation of the law and regulations in the airspace near Nevatim Airbase on Friday morning. The base is one of the Israeli Air Force’s most sensitive installations.

According to a report by Doron Kadosh, the paraglider did not enter the base’s grounds but landed nearby, in an area inhabited by Bedouins. The incident was reported to the Israel Police.

flash_695516.description:
The Central Elections Committee announced that voting for the 26th Knesset has concluded at Israeli missions around the world. Of the 4,863 eligible voters, 4,218 cast their ballots, representing a turnout of 86.7% - an increase of 17.1 percentage points compared with the previous election.

Voting took place at 101 polling stations across 99 Israeli missions, beginning in New Zealand and ending on the US West Coast. The ballot envelopes will be transferred to Israel ahead of the vote count.

flash_695515.description: Footage from Abu Falah appears to show Israeli youths helping photographer Heidi Levine to her feet, despite claims that hilltop youth kicked her 50 times and broke her legs.

flash_695514.description:
Two haredi draft evaders were randomly stopped by police in Rishon Lezion on Thursday. After it was determined that both were classified as IDF deserters, they were transferred to the Military Police in accordance with established procedures.

According to a haredi organization that assists draft evaders, the two were sentenced to 20 days in military jail on Friday.

flash_695513.description:
The IDF responded to the attack on a Washington post photographer, saying: "Earlier today (Friday), IDF and Border Police forces were dispatched to an area adjacent to Khirbet Abu Falah, following a report of a violent confrontation. Foreign media personnel were present at the scene and a female journalist had been injured during the confrontation. All circumstances surrounding the incident will be examined."

"Upon arriving at the scene, the forces acted to disperse the confrontation using riot dispersal means.

"At another location where the confrontation took place, IDF soldiers fired warning shots into the air and subsequently toward a suspect who ran toward them carrying a sharp object and posed a threat to them. The confrontation was dispersed."

The IDF added: "Police forces and forensic investigators from the Judea and Samaria District will enter the area with IDF security to collect findings and evidence, as well as take testimonies."

"The IDF strongly condemns this incident and views any manifestation of violence with utmost severity. Attempts to incite friction between populations undermine security in the area. Attacks and violence against innocent civilians are grave and unacceptable acts that require a coordinated, multi-agency response. The IDF will work together with the relevant authorities to eradicate this phenomenon."
